```{r}
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ",
    paste(
      missing_packages,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
params <- list(
  
  
  
  crc_stability_file =
    "bootstrap_validated_downstream_analysis/results/GSEA_bootstrap/CRC/CRC_GSVA_bootstrap_stability_summary.csv",

  ucec_stability_file =
    "bootstrap_validated_downstream_analysis/results/GSEA_bootstrap/UCEC/UCEC_GSVA_bootstrap_stability_summary.csv",

  
  
  
  primary_fdr_cutoff =
    0.05,

  tested_rate_cutoff =
    0.90,

  bootstrap_sign_consistency_cutoff =
    0.80,

  
  
  
  plotted_contrasts =
    c(
      "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L",
      "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H"
    ),

  
  
  
  comparison_colors =
    c(
      "MSS/TMB-L" = "#4C8FC0",
      "MSS/TMB-H" = "#C62828"
    ),

  
  
  
  effect_column =
    "primary_logFC",

  
  
  
  output_root =
    "bootstrap_validated_downstream_analysis/Hallmark_GSVA_relaxed_bootstrap_stability"
)

plot_dir <- file.path(
  params$output_root,
  "plots"
)

table_dir <- file.path(
  params$output_root,
  "tables"
)

dir.create(
  plot_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(

)
```

```{r}
check_file <- function(
    file,
    description
) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop(
      description,
      " not found:\n",
      file
    )
  }
}


read_gsva_stability <- function(
    file,
    dataset
) {
  check_file(
    file,
    paste0(
      dataset,
      " GSVA stability summary"
    )
  )

  x <- read.csv(
    file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  required <- c(
    "Contrast",
    "pathway",
    "primary_logFC",
    "primary_FDR",
    "tested_rate",
    "bootstrap_sign_consistency"
  )

  missing <- setdiff(
    required,
    names(
      x
    )
  )

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      " GSVA stability table is missing columns: ",
      paste(
        missing,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  if (!params$effect_column %in% names(x)) {
    stop(
      "Requested effect column '",
      params$effect_column,
      "' is not available."
    )
  }

  x %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Dataset =
        dataset,

      primary_logFC =
        as.numeric(
          primary_logFC
        ),

      primary_FDR =
        as.numeric(
          primary_FDR
        ),

      tested_rate =
        as.numeric(
          tested_rate
        ),

      bootstrap_sign_consistency =
        as.numeric(
          bootstrap_sign_consistency
        ),

      effect =
        as.numeric(
          .data[[
            params$effect_column
          ]]
        )
    )
}


crc_stability <- read_gsva_stability(
  params$crc_stability_file,
  "CRC"
)


ucec_stability <- read_gsva_stability(
  params$ucec_stability_file,
  "UCEC"
)
```

```{r}
apply_relaxed_stability <- function(
    x
) {
  x %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      relaxed_primary_significant =
        !is.na(
          primary_FDR
        ) &
        primary_FDR <=
        params$
          primary_fdr_cutoff,

      relaxed_tested_rate_pass =
        !is.na(
          tested_rate
        ) &
        tested_rate >=
        params$
          tested_rate_cutoff,

      relaxed_sign_consistency_pass =
        !is.na(
          bootstrap_sign_consistency
        ) &
        bootstrap_sign_consistency >=
        params$
          bootstrap_sign_consistency_cutoff,

      relaxed_bootstrap_stable =
        relaxed_tested_rate_pass &
        relaxed_sign_consistency_pass,

      relaxed_primary_and_bootstrap_stable =
        relaxed_primary_significant &
        relaxed_bootstrap_stable
    )
}


crc_relaxed <- apply_relaxed_stability(
  crc_stability
)


ucec_relaxed <- apply_relaxed_stability(
  ucec_stability
)
```

```{r}
make_comparison_summary <- function(
    x
) {
  out <- x %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast %in%
        params$
          plotted_contrasts
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Dataset,
      Contrast
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Pathways_tested =
        dplyr::n(),

      Primary_FDR_005 =
        sum(
          relaxed_primary_significant,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      Relaxed_stable =
        sum(
          relaxed_primary_and_bootstrap_stable,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      .groups =
        "drop"
    )

  if (
    "primary_and_bootstrap_stable" %in%
      names(
        x
      )
  ) {
    strict_counts <- x %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Contrast %in%
          params$
            plotted_contrasts
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(
        Dataset,
        Contrast
      ) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Previous_strict_stable =
          sum(
            as.logical(
              primary_and_bootstrap_stable
            ),
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),

        .groups =
          "drop"
      )

    out <- out %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        strict_counts,
        by =
          c(
            "Dataset",
            "Contrast"
          )
      )
  }

  out
}


stability_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_comparison_summary(
    crc_relaxed
  ),

  make_comparison_summary(
    ucec_relaxed
  )
)


stability_comparison


write.csv(
  stability_comparison,
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "strict_vs_relaxed_stable_pathway_counts.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
diagnostic_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  crc_relaxed,
  ucec_relaxed
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Contrast %in%
      params$
        plotted_contrasts
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Dataset,
    Contrast,
    pathway,
    primary_logFC,
    primary_FDR,
    tested_rate,
    bootstrap_sign_consistency,
    dplyr::any_of(
      c(
        "bootstrap_median_logFC",
        "bootstrap_logFC_q025",
        "bootstrap_logFC_q975",
        "bootstrap_FDR_same_direction_rate",
        "bootstrap_direction_stable",
        "bootstrap_robust_effect",
        "primary_and_bootstrap_stable"
      )
    ),
    relaxed_primary_significant,
    relaxed_tested_rate_pass,
    relaxed_sign_consistency_pass,
    relaxed_primary_and_bootstrap_stable
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Dataset,
    Contrast,
    dplyr::desc(
      relaxed_primary_and_bootstrap_stable
    ),
    primary_FDR
  )


write.csv(
```

```{r}
contrast_labels <- c(
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L" =
    "MSS/TMB-L",

  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H" =
    "MSS/TMB-H"
)


clean_pathway_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_remove(
      "^HALLMARK_"
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "_",
      " "
    )
}


prepare_plot_table <- function(
    x
) {
  stable_df <- x %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast %in%
        params$
          plotted_contrasts,

      relaxed_primary_and_bootstrap_stable,

      !is.na(
        effect
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Comparison =
        unname(
          contrast_labels[
            Contrast
          ]
        ),

      Comparison =
        factor(
          Comparison,
          levels = c(
            "MSS/TMB-L",
            "MSS/TMB-H"
          )
        )
    )

  if (nrow(stable_df) == 0) {
    return(
      stable_df
    )
  }

  
  pathway_order <- stable_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      pathway
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      ordering_effect =
        if (
          any(
            Contrast ==
              "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
          )
        ) {
          effect[
            which(
              Contrast ==
                "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
            )[1]
          ]
        } else {
          effect[1]
        },

      .groups =
        "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      dplyr::desc(
        ordering_effect
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      pathway
    )

  stable_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Pathway =
        clean_pathway_name(
          pathway
        ),

      Pathway =
        factor(
          Pathway,
          levels =
            rev(
              clean_pathway_name(
                pathway_order
              )
            )
        )
    )
}


crc_plot_df <- prepare_plot_table(
  crc_relaxed
)


ucec_plot_df <- prepare_plot_table(
  ucec_relaxed
)


write.csv(
  crc_plot_df,

)
```

```{r}
plot_relaxed_stable_gsva <- function(
    df,
    dataset,
    output_stub
) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning(
      dataset,
      ": no pathways passed the relaxed stability criteria."
    )

    return(
      NULL
    )
  }

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x =
        effect,

      y =
        Pathway,

      fill =
        Comparison
    )
  ) +

    ggplot2::geom_col(
      position =
        ggplot2::position_dodge(
          width =
            0.72,
          preserve =
            "single"
        ),

      width =
        0.64
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept =
        0,

      linewidth =
        0.45,

      color =
        "grey50"
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values =
        params$
          comparison_colors,

      breaks = c(
        "MSS/TMB-L",
        "MSS/TMB-H"
      ),

      drop =
        FALSE,

      name =
        "Comparison"
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title =
        "Bootstrap-stable pathway expression (GSVA) in MSI-H",

      x =
        "logFC vs other subtype",

      y =
        "Pathway"
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_minimal(
      base_size =
        11
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          hjust =
            0.5,

          size =
            12
        ),

      axis.title.x =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            14
        ),

      axis.title.y =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            18
        ),

      axis.text.y =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            8.5,

          color =
            "grey35"
        ),

      axis.text.x =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            9,

          color =
            "grey35"
        ),

      panel.grid.major.y =
        ggplot2::element_line(
          color =
            "grey90",

          linewidth =
            0.35
        ),

      panel.grid.major.x =
        ggplot2::element_line(
          color =
            "grey90",

          linewidth =
            0.35
        ),

      panel.grid.minor =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      legend.position =
        "bottom",

      plot.margin =
        ggplot2::margin(
          8,
          8,
          8,
          8
        )
    )

  n_pathways <- dplyr::n_distinct(
    df$Pathway
  )

  plot_height <- max(
    6,
    0.28 *
      n_pathways +
      2
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename =
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0(
          output_stub,
          ".svg"
        )
      ),

    plot =
      p,

    width =
      8.5,

    height =
      plot_height,

    device =
      "svg"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename =
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0(
          output_stub,
          ".pdf"
        )
      ),

    plot =
      p,

    width =
      8.5,

    height =
      plot_height,

    device =
      grDevices::
        cairo_pdf
  )

  p
}
```
